record.question: With which country did the Ministry of Coal signed MOU on cooperation in the field of coal mining?
record.explanation: Answer C: Poland. India’s Ministry of Coal signed the coal-mining cooperation memorandum with Poland on 4 February 2019. The ministry’s own announcement identifies Poland and the event. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=1562612&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
